program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (grid)
  (let* ((height (rows grid))
         (width (cols grid))
         (objs (objects grid 0)))
    (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
      (let ((new-color
              (if (or (= (obj-r1 obj) 0)
                      (= (obj-c1 obj) 0)
                      (= (obj-r2 obj) (- height 1))
                      (= (obj-c2 obj) (- width 1)))
                  2
                  8)))
        (recolor-cells acc (obj-cells obj) new-color)))
      grid
      objs))))
